philippines.title: Sara Duterte glad ICC judges got to see dad’s condition
philippines.description:
Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said she was happy that the International Criminal Court (ICC) judges saw the physical state of her father Rodrigo Duterte during a recent procedural hearing on the charges of crimes against humanity against him. The former president personally appeared for the very first time during the ICC Trial Chamber III’s third status conference last Wednesday. “I am glad that a status conference was held and the judges finally saw the state of PRD. You can see that he is of advanced age, and hopefully, they can discuss the state of his health,” the Vice President […]...

philippines.title: Asian Games: China's Zhang beats Japan rivals to gymnastics gold
philippines.description:
NAGOYA–A “more mature” Zhang Boheng won the men’s all-around gymnastics gold at the Asian Games on Monday, beating his Japanese rivals ahead of next month’s world championships. China’s Zhang overcame an injury niggle to win gold in Nagoya ahead of Paris Olympics champion Shinnosuke Oka and reigning world champion Daiki Hashimoto. Zhang will hope to repeat the feat at next month’s world championships in Rotterdam and he said he had grown as an athlete. “I have kept reviewing my own shortcomings,” said Zhang, who finished second behind Oka at the Paris Olympic Games and again behind Hashimoto at the most recent […]...
